author: Natalie St. Denis
title: Arrest made in Albany apartment stabbing incident - NewsBreak
text:
By Natalie St. Denis ,
1 hours ago
ALBANY, N.Y. ( NEWS10 ) — The Albany Police Department arrested a woman in connection with a stabbing that took place at Capital Green apartments on Central Avenue on Tuesday afternoon. 45-year-old Ronita Roberts, of Albany, was arrested on Wednesday morning.
Download our WTEN+ streaming app on Roku, Fire TV and Apple TV! An investigation determined that Roberts and the 67-year-old victim were involved in an altercation inside an apartment located at 400 Central Ave. During the incident, Roberts allegedly slashed the victim in the neck with a knife. Prior to fleeing, Roberts allegedly also stole a credit card belonging to the victim.
Get the latest news, weather, sports and entertainment delivered right to your inbox! Roberts was taken into custody in the area of Quail Street and Washington Avenue by members of the Albany Police Department’s Criminal Investigation Unit. She was charged with the following:
Attempted murder in the second degree Robbery in the first degree Criminal possession of a weapon in the fourth degree Roberts was arraigned in Albany City Criminal Court Wednesday afternoon and remanded to the Albany County Jail.
